data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact 0b13382ebfe2 CONTRADICTS the neighbourhood on the solvability boundary: the neighbourhood mechanisms (SRC_001, SRC_003, SRC_004) silently produce an odd-centred triple whenever S ≡ 0 mod 3 but S/3 is odd, whereas 0b13382ebfe2 treats the even-parity constraint as a precondition on the mean itself, concluding 'no even solution exists' for such S. REFUTED IF the isolated artifact does not address the case where the mean is odd but S is divisible by 3, or if it silently produces the same odd-centred triple without flagging the parity violation.
